descriptions.tsonnet_b37_fade_800f1b58: Advances a value by the unsigned count elapsed since the stored stamp, scaled by a global factor: subtracted when a flag is set, otherwise added. The value is limited between two global bounds (through pointer-returning min/max over stack copies) and passed with argument 1 to virtual slot 13 of each of two held objects. Field meanings are inferred. The constants' values and the behavior of the two slot calls have not been tested.
